messages.meaning: Source-reported messages; not prompts, requests or sessions.

gpt_messages.meaning: GPT message subset; never add to messages.

tool_messages.meaning: Tool message subset; API Tool is not OpenAI API consumption.

project_messages.meaning: Project message subset; never add to messages.

message_breakdown.meaning: Map entries by category and key; overlapping breakdowns, not additional messages.

sessions.meaning: Native distinct sessions within one user/product/period only.

commits.meaning: Native coding commit count; not an activity or value equivalent.

lines_added.meaning: Native lines added; not accepted lines or productivity.

lines_removed.meaning: Native lines removed; not accepted lines or productivity.

accepted_lines_added.meaning: Native accepted lines added; subset, not additive to lines added.

accepted_lines_removed.meaning: Native accepted lines removed; subset, not additive to lines removed.

tabs_accepted.meaning: Native accepted tab suggestions; subset of shown.

composer_requests.meaning: Cursor native composer request count; no inferred overlap rules.

is_active.meaning: Native user-period activity flag; not a unique portfolio person.

reported_charge.meaning: Fixture-reported amount, not list estimate, allocated seat cost or verified invoice.

anthropic_enterprise_users.supported: One-day per-user engagement, including unified Chat/Cowork kept as separate potentially overlapping channels.
anthropic_enterprise_users.limitations: No org DAU/WAU/MAU, seats, feature endpoints, Console or Bedrock. User shape differs from brief actor shape. No live validation.

anthropic_grouped_cost.supported: Illustrative actor/model/product grouped costs. Decimal cents retained and converted exactly to native-currency major units.
anthropic_grouped_cost.limitations: Only actor/model/product grouping with other dimensions null. list_amount is unverified and deliberately not mapped. No invoice reconciliation or live validation.

chatgpt_workspace_csv.supported: Partial Users CSV, native period, seat_type, message counts and JSON-encoded message-map child facts.
chatgpt_workspace_csv.limitations: CSV is not an API schema. Cadence does not override period bounds. GPT/Project exports and surveys deferred; no invented Analytics API route. No seat price or developer API cost.

cursor_daily_usage.supported: Per-user native day, activity, coding counts, chat/agent/composer requests.
cursor_daily_usage.limitations: Fixture only; docs-qualified shape, not live validation. No spend/events/agent-edits adapters. Pagination completeness must be declared.

deferred_sources.microsoft: Existing collectors remain unchanged. No safe exported fixture contract was identified for reuse in this increment.
deferred_sources.github_copilot: Credits already covered by the existing optional Fabric feed. Usage-report adapter and identity mapping deferred.
deferred_sources.openai_developer: Optional separate provider; usage, tokens and dollars must never be treated as ChatGPT seats.
deferred_sources.anthropic_usage: Tokens/requests and Console channels deferred; no totals inferred from messages.
deferred_sources.chatgpt_analytics_api: Route, response schema and pagination unverified; no stub that implies readiness.

invariants: No universal person key, automatic email joins, unique-person total or cross-provider activity score.
No cross-source, cross-period, cross-product or cross-currency totals.
Unknown metrics are absent facts with quality counters, never zero-filled.
All numeric fact values are decimal strings; native boolean values remain boolean.
Keep native period bounds, boundary convention, cadence, currency, unit and amount.
Evidence level qualifies schema, not data authenticity. All supported input is synthetic or licensed fixture data.
No network access, prompt/response content, credentials, compliance or eDiscovery records.
